name: GL_PURGE_SETUP_
description: This table stores information about the archive and purge of data for each business object. It stores whether archive and purge is enabled, whether partitioning has been done, and whether the PARTITION_GROUP_CODE and PERIOD_NAME columns have been populated for historical data.

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Business object for which archive and purge setup is being done. Some valid values are ORA_GL_JOURNALS and ORA_GL_BALANCES.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_AND_PURGE_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether archive and purge should be done for this business object.

columns.name: PARTITIONING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the table partitioning. Some valid values are ORA_SUBMITTED, ORA_RUNNING, ORA_SUCCESS, ORA_VALIDATION_ERROR, and ORA_FATAL_ERROR.

columns.name: UPGRADE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the population of the PARTITION_GROUP_CODE and PERIOD_NAME columns for historical data. Some valid values are ORA_SUBMITTED, ORA_RUNNING, ORA_SUCCESS, and ORA_FATAL_ERROR.

columns.name: PARTITIONING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Services Scheduler request that partitioned the table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RETENTION_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Location where the archived data, which is no longer used, is being retained for the legal retention period. Valid values are ORA_EXTERNAL for external storage and ORA_LOCAL for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

columns.name: RETENTION_CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Level at which to retain the archived data for the specified number of years. Only applicable if the retention location is Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP. Valid values are ORA_BUSINESS_OBJECT, ORA_LEDGER, and ORA_LEGAL_ENTITY.

columns.name: RETENTION_YEARS
columns.description: Default number of years to retain the archived data for the business object. Only applicable if the retention location is Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_RETENTION_YEARS
columns.description: The number of years the transaction data for a business object to be retained before it can be archived.
